raw_message.text:
Hiring: *MTO - Dot Net Developer* at Decibel HRMS
📍 Location: *Shahra-e-Faisal, Karachi*
·Develop and maintain scalable web-based applications using C#, *ASP .NET with webforms* .
·Build and integrate REST APIs across systems.
·Create and manage SQL database objects: procedures, functions, and views.
·Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant field
·0-1 years of experience of backend development using .NET with webforms
📩 Interested candidates can apply at careers@decibel360.com by mentioning the position title "MTO - Dot Net Developer" in the subject line.

Dear Hiring Team at Decibel HRMS,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the MTO - Dot Net Developer position. As a 7th-semester Software Engineering student at Bahria University Karachi, I possess solid proficiency in C#, SQL database modeling, and RESTful API engineering.

While my primary web experience is with modern API architectures, I have strong fundamentals in object-oriented C# and am eager to apply my technical grounding to your application stack. I have attached my tailored CV for your review.

Sincerely,
Fahad Bin Nasir
